name: Do I need a site feasibility consultation if I already own land in Carlsbad?
description: Yes, even if you own land in Carlsbad, a consultation ensures it's suitable for a tiny home, considering local zoning and environmental factors.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a site feasibility consultation if I already own land in Carlsbad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, even if you already own land in Carlsbad, a site feasibility consultation is highly recommended. Property ownership doesn't guarantee suitability for a tiny home due to Carlsbad's specific zoning bylaws, setback requirements, and utility infrastructure. A consultation ensures your land is permissible for your desired tiny home type and identifies any local environmental or access challenges unique to Carlsbad, preventing costly delays or non-compliance issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, even if you own land in Carlsbad, a consultation ensures it's suitable for a tiny home, considering local zoning and environmental factors.
